prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to do this recorded statement. Before we begin, do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on the highway in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward the east side of town. It was a weekday afternoon and traffic was moderately heavy.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes from the middle lane into the right lane because I needed to exit. I checked my mirror and signaled, and I started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle in the right lane was coming up beside me. I didn't see it in my blind spot. We sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jolt to the left.

Q: Did you or the other driver brake or swerve before impact?

A: I hit my brakes once I felt the contact. I don't think the other driver had time to do anything.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. When my car jolted, I was thrown against the seatbelt and then the door. My right shoulder hit the armrest and the frame. It hurts when I raise my arm above my head.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with my doctor for the shoulder.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
